data.one_liner: Base package for Conflict-free Replicated Data Types using SQL databases
data.what_it_does: Provides base functionality and abstraction for CRDTs backed by relational databases with support for Hybrid Local Clocks, query watching, and synchronization changesets.
use_when: You are building a local-first application requiring offline sync capabilities using SQL
You need conflict-free replicated data types backed by relational databases
avoid_when: You need an out-of-the-box concrete implementation without using a driver package like sqlite_crdt
You require a traditional full-featured ORM
strengths: Enables seamless synchronization across nodes via changesets
Uses Hybrid Local Clocks (HLC) for consistent snapshots
weaknesses: Abstract base package requiring a concrete implementation like sqlite_crdt
Automatically modifies table schemas by adding three internal columns
Deleted records are only flagged and not physically removed, requiring manual GDPR sanitization
data.setup_notes: Requires a concrete driver implementation package such as sqlite_crdt or postgres_crdt.

alternatives.name: sqlite3
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a direct SQLite database wrapper without CRDT logic.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard Flutter SQLite database storage without CRDT synchronization features.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a full-featured reactive type-safe SQL database library with code generation.
